advancements.ftboss.easter_egg_memory.de: In Sweet Apple Manor, knock on the door that should have stayed shut
advancements.ftboss.root.title: §6Farming Tales §7· §fBoss Compendium
advancements.ftboss.root.description: Ten champions, each holding their own ground — go and knock on every door
advancements.ftboss.boss_sugar_queen.spo: The whole manor falls still — even the wind, it turns out, tastes of sugar
advancements.ftboss.boss_sugar_queen.sla: The crown lies shattered; the sugar falls no more
advancements.ftboss.boss_meat_mountain.s: The block catches the light, and the cleaver falls — once, and again
The cleaver halts mid-air; the board is quiet at last
advancements.ftboss.boss_tea_tree.spotte: A wisp of fresh tea rises in the garden, and the leaves begin to murmur
The last breath of steam is gone; the branches bow, and say no more
advancements.ftboss.boss_wine_barrel.spo: A muffled thunder rolls up from below — oak grinding over stone
advancements.ftboss.boss_wine_barrel.sla: The wine runs dry; an empty barrel spins where it stood
advancements.ftboss.boss_rat_boss.spotte: First a rustle in the wall — then the whole floor begins to move
The last one slips into the dark; the granary holds
advancements.ftboss.boss_defect_core.spo: An overloaded hum drowns out the rain; sparks light up, one after another
advancements.ftboss.boss_defect_core.sla: The hum cuts out — only ozone, and code no one can read
A long howl splits the pasture, and the herd falls into line
advancements.ftboss.boss_benger.slain.de: The howl dies away; at last it steps aside
The sea arches into a blue-green shadow — the banquet has begun
The tide draws back and the surface closes, as if nothing had happened
advancements.ftboss.boss_slayer_all.desc: Five lords of the table, every blade laid down — half the road is behind you
advancements.ftboss.blood_pact.title: §cSanguine Bond
advancements.ftboss.blood_pact.descripti: Take it in hand — its crimson surface seems to thirst for blood
advancements.ftboss.boss_apple_boss.spot: The air turns cloyingly sweet; something in the shadows bows to you
advancements.ftboss.boss_apple_boss.slai: Honeycrisp falls; the sweetness clears, leaving only rust
advancements.ftboss.boss_compost_boss.sp: The air turns rich and thick — a figure descends from above
advancements.ftboss.boss_compost_boss.sl: The rainbow touches down; that one was worth the smell
advancements.ftboss.food_boss_slayer_all: All ten champions, not one left standing — from frosting to compost, you have tasted the whole road
advancements.ftboss.memories_end.title: §5§lEnd of Memory
advancements.ftboss.memories_end.descrip: Ten crests gutter out, one by one; that night halts at last — the manor need not play on

spell.ftboss.star_cross.effect: Lock a point while charging, then release two crossing star beams, each 12 blocks long and 1.4 blocks wide. Each enemy is hit once; leaving the cross or taking cover avoids damage.
spell.ftboss.star_cross.guide: Qizai's evocation spell. Lock a point while charging, then release two crossing star beams, each 12 blocks long and 1.4 blocks wide. Each enemy is hit once; leaving the cross or taking cover avoids damage. Obtain the full-power Legendary level-one scroll from the manor victory chest or Scroll Forge, then inscribe it into a spellbook.

spell.ftboss.sky_nova.effect: Qizai ascends and becomes untargetable, charging for 5 seconds before calling down a verdict that deals 500 magic damage to everything within 48 blocks.
spell.ftboss.sky_nova.guide: Qizai’s gigantic spell. While airborne it cannot be targeted or damaged, and the 5-second charge is your warning. On landing it deals a flat 500 magic damage to every enemy within 48 blocks. The damage ignores difficulty and buff multipliers — run out of range the moment it rises.
